description_en: Queries software in the software library in batches
name: ListSoftwarelibSoftware

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paging query. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paging query. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. This parameter is not supported by this operation. Use CurrentPage and PageSize for pagination
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。当前接口不支持该参数，请使用CurrentPage与PageSize进行分页
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page. This parameter is not supported by this operation. Use CurrentPage and PageSize for pagination
parameters.help_zh: 每页的最大条目数。当前接口不支持该参数，请使用CurrentPage与PageSize进行分页
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The software name. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 软件名称，支持模糊查询
parameters.name: software_name

parameters.help_en: The software classification ID. You can call [ListSoftwarelibClassify](~~ListSoftwarelibClassify~~) to obtain the value
parameters.name: classify_id

parameters.help_en:
The operating system to which the software package applies. Valid values:
Windows: Windows.
Mac(Apple): macOS with Apple silicon.
Mac(Intel): macOS with Intel processors
parameters.help_zh:
软件包适用的操作系统。取值：
Windows：Windows系统。
Mac(Apple)：Apple芯片的macOS系统。
Mac(Intel)：Intel芯片的macOS系统
parameters.name: os

parameters.help_en:
The software source. Valid values:
custom: custom software.
builtin: built-in software library
parameters.help_zh:
软件来源。取值：
custom：自定义软件。
builtin：内置软件库
parameters.name: source_type
